test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is : 'comprehensive'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• After reading the given sentence with the blank number (2), we can understand that the sentence implies that the **policy** can be act as a **system** which can be used as a main part from elementary to high school.
 
• Here, the appropriate word that is suitable for the given blank is 'comprehensive' as its meaning is to the ability of teaching all type of classes in the one school only
 
• So, **National Educational Policy is comprehensive** is synonymical with the phrase policy act as an framework to teach all type of classes.

Therefore, the correct answer is: comprehensive.
